subject: POC access playbook: validation steps and cutover windows
messages:
From: Emma Shaw <emma.shaw@orionhealth.com>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.com
Cc: liam.chen@orionhealth.com
Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC kickoff & MAP items we need to unblock

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the product demo yesterday — Orion Health is excited to get a small POC rolling. To make sure we hit the trial acceptance window, our security and infra teams asked me to capture the MAP items that must be complete before we start synthetic load testing. High-level asks: 

- Org seed + initial API key(s) for staging (non-production)
- Service account + role mapping for telemetry ingestion (we need a list of scopes)
- IP allowlist for your staging endpoint and VPC peering schedule
- Confirmation of data residency (US region) and KMS options

We'd like the POC to start internal validation on Aug 16 and run a 2-week evaluation. Can you confirm owners and feasible cutover windows for VPC peering? Liam (cc'd) is our infra lead if you want to coordinate directly.

Also, if you have an initial MAP or checklist you prefer, please attach.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Shaw
Senior Manager, Technical Evaluation
Orion Health

Attachment: initial_requirements_list.txt (text)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Emma Shaw <emma.shaw@orionhealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-02T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & MAP items we need to unblock

Hi Emma — great to hear. I pulled together a brief MAP playbook and a proposed validation cadence (attached). Quick answers up front:

- We can provision a staging org and two API keys (read/test + full) for your evaluation. Owner: Soojin Lee (Redwood). Target delivery: Aug 11.
- Service account + RBAC matrix: Ben will define required scopes. We'll deliver a minimal service account that can post logs / metrics and read inference traces.
- IP allowlist: please share the CIDR blocks you anticipate; we will mirror those on the staging load balancer.
- VPC peering: two 2-hour windows we can offer for peering negotiation & smoke tests: Aug 12 10:00–12:00 PT or Aug 13 18:00–20:00 PT. Pick one and we'll reserve capacity.
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys (AWS KMS) for Private deployments; for Hosted POC we can enable Redwood-managed encryption and demo KMS integration on request.

I'll attach: Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP with milestones), a short acceptance checklist, and an IP allowlist template. Please confirm the peering window and send your infra contact details (Liam confirmed above).

Next steps (high level):
1) We create the staging org + API keys (Aug 11) — action: Soojin
2) IP allowlist applied and service account created (Aug 12–13) — action: Ben
3) VPC peering followed by smoke tests (chosen window) — action: Ben + Liam
4) Evaluation validation (Aug 16–30) — action: Emma + Redwood QA

Looking forward — attaching MAP and checklist.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf (pdf); MAP_acceptance_checklist.docx (docx)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Emma Shaw <emma.shaw@orionhealth.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-03T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: POC kickoff & MAP items we need to unblock

On Mon, Aug 2, 2027 at 11:30 AM Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> I'll attach: Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP with milestones), a short acceptance checklist, and an IP allowlist template.

Emma / Liam — I'll lead the peering and staging config. A few technical details so your infra team can prepare:

- Staging endpoint: staging-api.redwood-inference-us-west-2.prod (we'll provide FQDN and the ephemeral LB IP once allocation completes)
- IP allowlist: we accept CSV of allowed /32 or /24 ranges. Attached a sample (orion_ip_allowlist.csv). Please include any egress NAT ranges used by your worker fleet.
- Service account: scope names: inference.submit, telemetry.write, metrics.read. We'll provide Terraform snippets for role binding if you prefer IaC.
- VPC peering requirements: shared subnets of /24 or larger; we require unique non-overlapping CIDRs. For the smoke window please expect brief token cold-starts — we'll hold burst capacity.

Proposed technical acceptance criteria (minimum):
1) API key can call /v1/generate with 100ms p50 on short prompts under staging load (we'll validate).
2) VPC peering established and ICMP traceroute between endpoints completes.
3) Telemetry visible in the shared prometheus endpoint with sample traces.

If those are acceptable, I'll ask ops to reserve the Aug 12 10:00–12:00 PT window. Also flagging: if KMS CMK is required for key wrapping during the POC, that will extend activation by ~48 hours (we can do it but need your KMS ARN).

Ben
Staff Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: orion_ip_allowlist.csv (csv)

From: Emma Shaw <emma.shaw@orionhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam Chen <liam.chen@orionhealth.com>
Date: 2027-08-05T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & MAP items we need to unblock

Thanks Ben — Aug 12 10:00–12:00 PT works for us for the peering window. Liam (cc) is our infra lead and will own the CIDR confirmations. Liam — we've captured the three Redwood scopes Ben listed; can your team provide the NAT egress ranges and confirm non-overlapping subnets?

Two additional asks from our Security:
- We need a short SOC 2 scoping note (what telemetry flows to Redwood, retention for logs used in evaluation) — can someone share a one-page bullet?
- If you can provide a temporary KMS option for encrypting test payloads that would be ideal; otherwise we can accept Redwood-managed for the POC.

DocuSign: our legal wants a short MSA amendment for the trial; I can route one if needed, but we'd prefer minimal redlines.

Thanks — confirming:
- Peering: Aug 12 10:00–12:00 PT
- Staging org/API keys: expect by Aug 11 from Redwood
- Evaluation start: Aug 16

Emma

Subject: Final MAP checkpoint & confirmation for cutover

Emma — thanks for the confirmation. Quick summary and final MAP checkpoint before we lock everything in: 

MAP summary (final):
- Org + staging API keys: delivered Aug 11 (soojin.lee@redwood.com) — keys: redwood-stg-read-xx / redwood-stg-full-xx (rotated).
- Service account + RBAC: created Aug 12 07:00 PT — scopes: inference.submit, telemetry.write, metrics.read (owner: Ben Carter).
- IP allowlist: applied Aug 12 09:30 PT using the CSV you provided (attachment).
- VPC peering: established Aug 12 10:08 PT; smoke tests complete by 10:42 PT. Ops verified traceroute and simple inference calls.
- KMS: we enabled Redwood-managed encryption for the hosted POC; if you supply an ARN we can switch to customer-managed keys within 48 hours.
- SOC2 scoping note: attached 1-pager covering telemetry, retention (14 days for evaluation traces), and contact for audit requests.

Action owners & dates: 
- Soojin Lee (Redwood): staging org, API key rotation, MAP doc (completed Aug 11)
- Ben Carter (Redwood): peering + service account (completed Aug 12)
- Liam Chen (Orion): provided egress ranges and verified CIDR non-overlap (completed Aug 11)
- Emma Shaw (Orion): evaluation validation lead, acceptance sign-off goal Aug 30

Next steps:
1) Redwood to share short runbook for keys & ephemeral token refresh (by Aug 15) — Soojin
2) Joint smoke run (light synthetic) on Aug 16 09:00 PT — all parties
3) If acceptance passes, we prepare a short close note and invoice waiver request for the evaluation term (Aug 30) — Sales to draft.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf; MAP_acceptance_checklist.docx; SOC2_scoping_note.pdf; orion_ip_allowlist.csv

If that aligns, I'll update the HubSpot deal and send a one-click calendar invite for the Aug 16 smoke run. Thanks everyone — excited to get this moving.

Best,
